thought.text: The loginToken is one-shot with a 30s TTL. Let me redo the Matrix SSO flow and use the token immediately in one sequence:

reasoning_content:
The loginToken has a TTL of 30 seconds (according to the code, `@login_token_ttl_seconds 30`), and my capture from earlier has expired. Also, that earlier successful exchange was actually the first token I exchanged. But the re-run of the exchange just now — no wait, on the second run I re-exchanged the same token (already consumed), or it was expired.

Actually, looking at the first exchange: it succeeded and returned an access_token for @alex:localhost. But I didn't save that. The second exchange attempt (in this last command) re-used m_final_url.txt, but that loginToken was one-shot (pop_login_token) and expired.

Let me redo the whole Matrix SSO flow fresh, and within the 30-second window, save the token and immediately use it. Let me do it in one quick command.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
set -e
REDIR="http://localhost:8008/capture"
curl -s -D m1.txt --max-time 10 "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login/sso/redirect/oidc?redirectUrl=$REDIR" -o /dev/null
AUTH=$(grep -i '^location' m1.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
rm -f mdex.txt
curl -s -c mdex.txt --max-time 10 -L "$AUTH" -o mdexform.html
MFA=$(grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' mdexform.html | head -1 | sed 's/action="//;s/"//' | sed 's/&/\&/g')
curl -s -b mdex.txt -c mdex.txt --data-urlencode "login=alex@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=changeme" -D mdexh.txt -o /dev/null -e "http://dex:5556${MFA}" "http://dex:5556${MFA}"
M_CB=$(grep -i '^location:' mdexh.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
curl -s -D mcbh.txt --max-time 20 "$M_CB" -o /dev/null
LTOKEN=$(grep -i '^location' mcbh.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/.*loginToken=//')
echo "loginToken: ${LTOKEN:0:20}..."
# Exchange immediately
LOGIN=$(curl -s --max-time 20 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"type\":\"m.login.token\",\"token\":\"$LTOKEN\"}" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login)
echo "LOGIN: $LOGIN" | cut -c1-60
echo "$LOGIN" > alex_login.json
TOKEN=$(echo "$LOGIN" | sed 's/.*"access_token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
echo "$TOKEN" > alex_token.txt
# Create room immediately
ROOM=$(curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Test Room","room_alias_name":"testroom","visibility":"private","topic":"install verification"}' http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/createRoom)
echo "createRoom: $ROOM"
ROOM_ID=$(echo "$ROOM" | sed 's/.*"room_id":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
echo "$ROOM_ID" > alex_room.txt
# Send a message
curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"msgtype":"m.text","body":"Hello from Nebu install verification"}' "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/$ROOM_ID/send/m.room.message/txn1"
echo
# Read back
curl -s --max-time 20 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/$ROOM_ID/messages?dir=b&limit=5" | head -c 500
echo
echo "ROOM_ID=$ROOM_ID"
